accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.subtitle: Get your issued invoices into your accounting software or to your accountant.
accounting.programsTitle: Which program do you or your accountant use?
accounting.programHoldedHow: Direct sync: every invoice is sent to your Holded account automatically.
accounting.programOthersHow: Export: download the issued-invoices book and hand it to your accountant to import. These programs offer no direct connection we can use.
accounting.holdedIntro: Paste your Holded account's API key here (in Holded: Settings > API > Generate new key).
accounting.holdedScopes: Give it these permissions: read taxes, read and write contacts, read and write sales invoices.
accounting.holdedKeyStored: We store it encrypted and only use it to send your invoices to Holded.
accounting.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Holded? New invoices will no longer be sent.
accounting.syncOnIssue: Send each invoice to Holded when it is issued
accounting.syncOnIssueHelp: If off, invoices wait until you press "Send pending".
accounting.howItWorks: Invoices arrive in Holded as drafts, with the same number as in KiraRoom. We do not approve them: KiraRoom already issued them (and, with VERI*FACTU on, already reported them to the tax agency). If your Holded also has VERI*FACTU, only approve them if your accountant tells you to, so they are not reported twice.
accounting.limitsNote: If you cancel an invoice that is already in Holded, we cancel it there too; if Holded does not allow it (for example, it is already paid), the log shows it as not reflected in Holded and you need to cancel it there yourself. Corrective invoices are not sent automatically: they are in the invoice book. Holded limits API calls by plan (e.g. 500 a month on Plus) and each invoice uses 2 or 3.
accounting.pushFromHelp: Optional: to bring invoices from before you connected Holded.
accounting.exportIntro: For Sage, A3, NCS or any accountant: one row per invoice and tax rate (the AEAT register layout), with date, series and number, customer tax ID and name, tax ({tax}), rate, taxable base, tax amount and total.
accounting.exportNote: Includes issued, paid and refunded invoices in the period; drafts and cancelled invoices are left out. One year at most per download.
accounting.exportFailed: The invoice book could not be downloaded.
accounting.ownerOnly: Only the salon owner can connect or disconnect Holded.

channels.title: Virtual receptionist channels
channels.subtitle: The receptionist answers with the same rules on your website, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram and Telegram.

channels.metaStep1: Create a Facebook Page for your salon if you don't have one yet.

channels.telegramStep3: Assign a public name and a username ending in 'bot' (e.g. my_salon_bot).
channels.telegramStep4: Copy the token BotFather returns and paste it below.
channels.telegramTokenHelp: Format: 123456789:ABC-DEF... Don't share it with anyone else.

loyalty.expiry_help: Every paid visit or purchase renews all the client's points. If that long passes without one, the whole balance expires (it stays in their history as «Caducidad»); accumulated points and the tier are kept. When you switch it on or shorten it, nobody loses points during the first 30 days.

loyalty.tiers_help: A member moves up a tier by accumulating points, and from that tier earns more points per visit or per euro. They never go down: not when redeeming, not after a refund or a cancellation, not when you change the tiers. When you create or edit a tier, members who already reached it move up to it.

guide.title: How to get these details (about 10 minutes)
guide.step1: Go to business.facebook.com with the account that manages the salon's WhatsApp Business and open "Business settings".
guide.step2: Under "Users" → "System users", create one with the admin role (or use the one you have).
guide.step3: Press "Assign assets", choose your WhatsApp account and give it full control.
guide.step4: Press "Generate new token", tick the whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions and choose that it never expires. Copy the token: it is the "Access token".
guide.step5: In WhatsApp Manager, under "Phone numbers", copy the number's id ("Number id in Meta") and the WhatsApp Business account id.
guide.step6: Paste them here and press "Connect". We check them with Meta before saving; then press "Test reception" to see that messages arrive.
guide.note: Do not use the temporary token from "API Setup": it expires in 24 hours. If the token belongs to another Meta app, sending works but received messages go to that app; we will tell you when you connect.
